optimizedContext.value:
# TypeScript Language Adapter

## Rules
- `TypeScriptLanguageAdapter`: `.ts`→`typescript`, `.tsx`→`tsx`, `.js`→`javascript`, `.jsx`→`jsx`. Parse content once through registered Tree-sitter/ast-grep; emit complete `FileAnalysisDraft`; no source reread or persisted AST.
- Emit deterministic symbols, imports, scopes/bindings/calls/references, compact serializable parser state; parser runtime survives only indexing session.
- Extract functions; callable variables/arrows/HOF wrappers; classes; class/object methods and fields; prototype/static and namespace/member assignments; destructuring; exported variables; aliases; interfaces; enums; properties.
- Construct range = full parser node; `selectionRange` = declared identifier; retain attached JSDoc/block/contiguous-line comments verbatim; omit invalid/rangeless candidates.
- Omit non-callable property when anonymous enclosing object crosses array boundary before supported named declaration, including direct/nested array records. Preserve scalar properties under named objects through parentheses/assertions/`as const`/`satisfies`; always preserve callable values/methods. Never alter source; preserve parser ranges.
- Logical declaration space follows proven kind. Member owner derives parser containment then logical owner, never parser ID/`parentId`; distinct same-name owners stay distinct; top-level has none. Preserve proven `MemberSemantics`; unsupported-owner method-like occurrences remain location-backed without logical-member facts.
- Extract static named/default/namespace/type-only/side-effect/aliased imports, literal `import()`/`require()`, ESM/CJS exports, named/star re-exports; discard nonliteral dynamic loads.
- Public bindings preserve surface, exported name, space, target, every ordered re-export route; Pass 2 never collapses routes. Relative candidates include extensions/index; package imports use known identities.
- Emit deterministic typed parameter, constructor property, field, return, type-RHS, `this`, construction, alias, scope facts. Emit `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE` only from proven local/import/receiver/index evidence; caller = innermost callable; drop module-scope, ambiguous, computed, runtime-only.
- Resolve class/interface `extends`, class `implements`, proven same-form replacement into `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. Preserve child/ancestor/contract, relation, precedence, ordered provenance, alternate routes; cycles terminate. `hierarchy: true` only with sufficient evidence.
- Package identity = nearest bounded `package.json.name`; bare/scoped package uses longest known prefix; filesystem walk stops at repo root.
- `buildContext: false`: no tsconfig inheritance/references/`baseUrl`/`paths`, platform conditions, conditional `exports`/`imports`.
- Advertise only actually emitted shared capabilities. Unsupported/incomplete/parse-failed semantics produce coverage, never name-only guesses. Output/provenance ordering deterministic.

## Constraints
- No project-code execution or implicit TypeScript compiler fallback.
- Runtime reflection, computed exports, monkey patching, unproven interprocedural flow unsupported.
- TypeScript syntax stays adapter; generic resolver consumes shared facts only.
